"""Interface unificada dos componentes executáveis da versão 2.0."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from dataclasses import asdict
import json
from pathlib import Path

import torch

from .common import atomic_json, device_for, json_default, new_run, seed_everything


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Ouroboros Engine 2.0 — laboratório executável")
    parser.add_argument("--version", action="version", version="2.0.0")
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    doctor_parser = commands.add_parser("doctor", help="Verifica pacotes e hashes das fontes upstream")
    experiment = commands.add_parser("experiment", help="Executa todos os experimentos e avaliações")
    experiment.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    experiment.add_argument("--profile", choices=["quick", "full"], default="full")
    experiment.add_argument("--require-success", action="store_true")
    experiment.add_argument("--world-episodes", type=int)
    bootstrap = commands.add_parser("bootstrap", help="Treina o decoder de bytecode")
    bootstrap.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    bootstrap.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=400)
    synthesis = commands.add_parser("synthesize", help="Busca uma composição a partir de exemplos numéricos")
    synthesis.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    synthesis.add_argument("--generations", type=int, default=120)
    synthesis.add_argument("--coefficients", type=int, nargs=3, default=[3, 2, -1])
    synthesis.add_argument("--examples", type=Path, help="JSON de treino, validação e teste, sem código da solução")
    generate = commands.add_parser("generate", help="Gera candidatos de bytecode para uma nova especificação")
    generate.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    generate.add_argument("--examples", type=Path, required=True)
    generate.add_argument("--checkpoint", type=Path, required=True)
    generate.add_argument("--samples", type=int, default=16)
    language = commands.add_parser("communication", help="Treina o jogo de informação assimétrica")
    language.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    language.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=1500)
    language.add_argument("--protocol", choices=["free", "factorized"], default="factorized")
    language.add_argument("--resume", type=Path)
    morphology = commands.add_parser("morphology", help="Executa crescimento, poda e reconexão")
    morphology.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    neat = commands.add_parser("neat", help="Evolui um controlador com NEAT-Python upstream")
    neat.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    neat.add_argument("--generations", type=int, default=25)
    world = commands.add_parser("world", help="Treina o cérebro CfC/morfogênico no mundo cooperativo")
    world.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    world.add_argument("--language", type=Path, required=True)
    world.add_argument("--episodes", type=int, default=24)
    world.add_argument("--batch", type=int, default=32)
    world.add_argument("--horizon", type=int, default=80)
    vm = commands.add_parser("vm", help="Executa assembly ou compila a DSL imperativa")
    vm.add_argument("source", type=Path)
    vm.add_argument("--compile", action="store_true")
    vm.add_argument("--inputs", type=float, nargs="*", default=[])
    vm.add_argument("--array", type=float, nargs="*", default=[])
    vm.add_argument("--fuel", type=int, default=4000)
    vm.add_argument("--trace", action="store_true")
    dashboard = commands.add_parser("dashboard", help="Painel da versão 2.0 e console da VM")
    dashboard.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    dashboard.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    dashboard.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8080)
    for sub in (experiment, bootstrap, synthesis, generate, language, morphology, neat, world):
        sub.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
        sub.add_argument("--device", choices=["cpu", "cuda", "auto"], default="auto")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if hasattr(args, "seed"): seed_everything(args.seed)
    if args.command == "doctor":
        from .integrations import doctor
        report = doctor()
        print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        return 0 if all(p["ok"] for p in report["upstream"]) else 1
    if args.command == "dashboard":
        from .dashboard import serve
        serve(args.output, args.host, args.port)
        return 0
    if args.command == "vm":
        from .vm import Limits, Machine, assemble, compile_source
        source = args.source.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        program = compile_source(source) if args.compile else assemble(source)
        result = Machine(Limits(fuel=args.fuel)).run(program, args.inputs, args.array, args.trace)
        print(json.dumps(asdict(result), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        return 0 if result.ok else 1
    device = device_for(args.device)
    if args.command == "experiment":
        from .experiment import run_experiment
        override = {"world_episodes": args.world_episodes} if args.world_episodes is not None else None
        report = run_experiment(args.output, args.profile, args.seed, args.device, override)
        print(json.dumps({"output": str(args.output), "checks": report["checks"]}, indent=2))
        return 1 if args.require_success and not report["all_checks_passed"] else 0
    directory = new_run(args.output)
    if args.command == "bootstrap":
        from .experiment import bootstrap_programmer
        _, report = bootstrap_programmer(directory, args.epochs, args.seed, device)
    elif args.command == "synthesize":
        from .experiment import run_synthesis
        from .programming.tasks import task_from_examples
        task = task_from_examples(args.examples) if args.examples else None
        report = run_synthesis(directory, args.generations, args.seed, tuple(args.coefficients), task)
    elif args.command == "generate":
        from .programming.generation import generate_candidates, load_programmer
        from .programming.tasks import task_from_examples
        model = load_programmer(args.checkpoint, device)
        report = generate_candidates(model, task_from_examples(args.examples), directory, args.samples)
    elif args.command == "communication":
        from .communication import CommunicationGame, GameConfig, train_communication
        model = CommunicationGame(GameConfig(protocol=args.protocol)).to(device)
        report = train_communication(model, directory, args.steps, seed=args.seed, resume=args.resume)
    elif args.command == "morphology":
        from .experiment import structural_experiment
        report = structural_experiment(directory, args.seed, device)
    elif args.command == "neat":
        from .evolution.neat_control import evolve_controller
        _, report = evolve_controller(directory, args.generations, args.seed)
    elif args.command == "world":
        from .communication.training import load_game
        from .world import ArenaConfig
        from .world.training import train_world
        model, _ = load_game(args.language, device)
        _, report = train_world(model, directory, args.episodes, ArenaConfig(batch=args.batch, horizon=args.horizon), seed=args.seed)
    print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, default=json_default))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Persistência atômica e reprodutibilidade compartilhadas pelos experimentos."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, is_dataclass
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import random
import time

import numpy as np
import torch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]


def seed_everything(seed: int, threads: int = 1) -> None:
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    torch.set_num_threads(threads)


def device_for(name: str) -> torch.device:
    if name not in ("cpu", "cuda", "auto"):
        raise ValueError("device deve ser cpu, cuda ou auto")
    if name == "auto":
        name = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
    if name == "cuda" and not torch.cuda.is_available():
        raise RuntimeError("CUDA indisponível nesta máquina")
    return torch.device(name)


def json_default(value):
    if is_dataclass(value):
        return asdict(value)
    if isinstance(value, Path):
        return str(value)
    if isinstance(value, (np.integer, np.floating)):
        return value.item()
    if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor):
        return value.detach().cpu().tolist()
    raise TypeError(type(value).__name__)


def atomic_json(path: Path, data) -> None:
    path = Path(path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False,
                                    indent=2, default=json_default) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    os.replace(temporary, path)


def stable_hash(data) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
                                     allow_nan=False, default=json_default).encode()).hexdigest()


def new_run(path: Path) -> Path:
    path = Path(path)
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if any(path.iterdir()):
        raise FileExistsError(f"Use uma pasta vazia para preservar execuções: {path}")
    return path


class Journal:
    """Um registro por evento; o snapshot é substituído atomicamente."""

    def __init__(self, directory: Path):
        self.directory = Path(directory)
        self.directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.started = time.monotonic()

    def record(self, event: str, **fields):
        record = dict(event=event, elapsed=time.monotonic() - self.started, **fields)
        encoded = json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, default=json_default)
        with (self.directory / "events.jsonl").open("a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            stream.write(encoded + "\n")
        atomic_json(self.directory / "latest.json", record)
        return record


def wilson_interval(successes: int, trials: int, z: float = 1.96):
    if trials < 1 or not 0 <= successes <= trials:
        raise ValueError("Contagens binomiais inválidas")
    p = successes / trials
    denominator = 1 + z * z / trials
    center = (p + z * z / (2 * trials)) / denominator
    spread = z * math.sqrt(p * (1 - p) / trials + z * z / (4 * trials * trials)) / denominator
    return [max(0.0, center - spread), min(1.0, center + spread)]

"""Jogo referencial de Lewis: somente o emissor conhece o referente correto."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import math

import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F


@dataclass
class GameConfig:
    colors: int = 4
    shapes: int = 4
    candidates: int = 4
    vocabulary: int = 8
    message_length: int = 3
    hidden: int = 64
    protocol: str = "free"

    def __post_init__(self):
        for key, value in vars(self).items():
            if key == "protocol": continue
            if type(value) is not int or value < 1: raise ValueError(f"Configuração inválida: {key}")
        if self.protocol not in {"free", "factorized"}: raise ValueError("Protocolo inválido")
        if self.protocol == "factorized" and self.message_length < 2: raise ValueError("Protocolo fatorado exige dois símbolos")
        if not 2 <= self.candidates <= self.colors * self.shapes:
            raise ValueError("Quantidade de candidatos incompatível com os conceitos")
        if self.colors < 2 or self.shapes < 2 or self.vocabulary < 2:
            raise ValueError("O jogo exige pelo menos dois valores por fator e dois símbolos")

    @property
    def concepts(self): return self.colors * self.shapes

    @property
    def features(self): return self.colors + self.shapes


@dataclass
class GameBatch:
    sender_observation: torch.Tensor
    receiver_candidates: torch.Tensor
    target_index: torch.Tensor
    target_concept: torch.Tensor


def feature_vectors(ids, config):
    return torch.cat((F.one_hot(ids // config.shapes, config.colors),
                      F.one_hot(ids % config.shapes, config.shapes)), -1).float()


def concept_partition(config, heldout=False):
    # Diagonal é reservada para avaliar combinações de atributos não treinadas.
    values = [i for i in range(config.concepts)
              if ((i // config.shapes) == (i % config.shapes)) == heldout]
    if not values: raise ValueError("Partição vazia")
    return values


def make_batch(config, size, device="cpu", generator=None, partition="train"):
    if size < 1 or partition not in {"train", "heldout", "all"}: raise ValueError("Batch inválido")
    concepts = (list(range(config.concepts)) if partition == "all" else concept_partition(config, partition == "heldout"))
    pool = torch.tensor(concepts, device=device)
    target = pool[torch.randint(len(pool), (size,), device=device, generator=generator)]
    # Distratores são distintos. A posição correta é embaralhada por exemplo.
    random_scores = torch.rand(size, config.concepts, device=device, generator=generator)
    random_scores.scatter_(1, target[:, None], -1)
    distractors = random_scores.topk(config.candidates - 1, dim=1).indices
    choices = torch.cat((target[:, None], distractors), dim=1)
    permutation = torch.rand(size, config.candidates, device=device, generator=generator).argsort(-1)
    choices = choices.gather(1, permutation)
    labels = (choices == target[:, None]).long().argmax(-1)
    return GameBatch(feature_vectors(target, config), feature_vectors(choices, config), labels, target)


class Sender(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, config):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        if config.protocol == "factorized":
            self.factor_heads = nn.ModuleList([
                nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(size, config.hidden), nn.Tanh(), nn.Linear(config.hidden, config.vocabulary))
                for size in (config.colors, config.shapes)])
            return
        self.encoder = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(config.features, config.hidden), nn.Tanh())
        self.embedding = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(config.vocabulary, config.hidden) * 0.1)
        self.cell = nn.GRUCell(config.hidden, config.hidden)
        self.head = nn.Linear(config.hidden, config.vocabulary)

    def forward(self, observation, temperature=1.0, discrete=False):
        if self.config.protocol == "factorized":
            parts = observation.split([self.config.colors, self.config.shapes], -1)
            messages, logits_list = [], []
            for slot in range(self.config.message_length):
                logits = self.factor_heads[slot % 2](parts[slot % 2])
                message = (F.one_hot(logits.argmax(-1), self.config.vocabulary).float() if discrete else
                           F.gumbel_softmax(logits, tau=temperature, hard=True, dim=-1))
                messages.append(message)
                logits_list.append(logits)
            return torch.stack(messages, 1), torch.stack(logits_list, 1)
        hidden = self.encoder(observation)
        previous = torch.zeros_like(hidden)
        messages, logits_list = [], []
        for _ in range(self.config.message_length):
            hidden = self.cell(previous, hidden)
            logits = self.head(hidden)
            if discrete:
                message = F.one_hot(logits.argmax(-1), self.config.vocabulary).float()
            else:
                message = F.gumbel_softmax(logits, tau=temperature, hard=True, dim=-1)
            messages.append(message)
            logits_list.append(logits)
            previous = message @ self.embedding
        return torch.stack(messages, 1), torch.stack(logits_list, 1)


class Receiver(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, config):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        if config.protocol == "factorized":
            self.factor_readouts = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(config.vocabulary, size, bias=False)
                                                 for size in (config.colors, config.shapes)])
            return
        self.embedding = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(config.vocabulary, config.hidden) * 0.1)
        self.decoder = nn.GRU(config.hidden, config.hidden, batch_first=True)
        self.candidates = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(config.features, config.hidden), nn.Tanh())

    def forward(self, messages, candidates):
        # Não recebe target_index, clue ou a observação privada do emissor.
        if self.config.protocol == "factorized":
            parts = candidates.split([self.config.colors, self.config.shapes], -1)
            scores = torch.zeros(candidates.shape[:2], device=candidates.device)
            for slot in range(self.config.message_length):
                affinity = self.factor_readouts[slot % 2](messages[:, slot])
                scores = scores + (parts[slot % 2] * affinity[:, None]).sum(-1)
            return scores
        _, state = self.decoder(messages @ self.embedding)
        options = self.candidates(candidates)
        return (options * state[0, :, None, :]).sum(-1) / math.sqrt(options.shape[-1])


class CommunicationGame(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, config=GameConfig()):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        self.sender, self.receiver = Sender(config), Receiver(config)

    def forward(self, batch, temperature=1.0, discrete=False):
        message, logits = self.sender(batch.sender_observation, temperature, discrete)
        return self.receiver(message, batch.receiver_candidates), message, logits

"""Treino por sucesso compartilhado e avaliação causal por ablação do canal."""
from __future__ import annotations

from collections import Counter
from dataclasses import asdict
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

import torch
from torch.nn import functional as F

from ..common import Journal, atomic_json, wilson_interval
from .game import CommunicationGame, GameConfig, make_batch


def message_statistics(concepts, messages):
    pairs = list(zip(concepts.tolist(), map(tuple, messages.tolist())))
    joint, concept_count, message_count = Counter(pairs), Counter(), Counter()
    for concept, message in pairs:
        concept_count[concept] += 1
        message_count[message] += 1
    n = len(pairs)
    mutual_information = sum(count / n * math.log2(count * n / (concept_count[c] * message_count[m]))
                             for (c, m), count in joint.items())
    entropy = -sum(count / n * math.log2(count / n) for count in message_count.values())
    lexicon = {}
    for concept in sorted(concept_count):
        choices = {message: count for (c, message), count in joint.items() if c == concept}
        message = max(choices, key=choices.get)
        lexicon[str(concept)] = {"symbols": list(message), "frequency": choices[message] / concept_count[concept]}
    return {"mutual_information_bits": mutual_information, "message_entropy_bits": entropy,
            "unique_messages": len(message_count), "lexicon": lexicon}


@torch.no_grad()
def evaluate_communication(model, trials=1024, seed=1234, partition="train"):
    if trials < 2: raise ValueError("Use pelo menos duas avaliações")
    device = next(model.parameters()).device
    generator = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(seed)
    batch = make_batch(model.config, trials, device, generator, partition)
    message, _ = model.sender(batch.sender_observation, discrete=True)
    permutation = torch.randperm(trials, device=device, generator=generator)
    random_symbols = torch.randint(model.config.vocabulary, (trials, model.config.message_length), device=device, generator=generator)
    channels = {"intact": message, "shuffled": message[permutation], "muted": torch.zeros_like(message),
                "random": F.one_hot(random_symbols, model.config.vocabulary).float()}
    results = {}
    for name, channel in channels.items():
        predictions = model.receiver(channel, batch.receiver_candidates).argmax(-1)
        passed = int((predictions == batch.target_index).sum().item())
        results[name] = dict(correct=passed, total=trials, accuracy=passed / trials,
                             ci95=wilson_interval(passed, trials))
    results["causal_drop_muted"] = results["intact"]["accuracy"] - results["muted"]["accuracy"]
    results["causal_drop_shuffled"] = results["intact"]["accuracy"] - results["shuffled"]["accuracy"]
    results["chance"] = 1 / model.config.candidates
    results["partition"] = partition
    results["statistics"] = message_statistics(batch.target_concept.cpu(), message.argmax(-1).cpu())
    return results


def save_checkpoint(path, model, optimizer, step, generator):
    torch.save({"schema": 2, "config": asdict(model.config), "model": model.state_dict(),
                "optimizer": optimizer.state_dict(), "step": step,
                "torch_rng": torch.get_rng_state(), "batch_rng": generator.get_state(),
                "cuda_rng": torch.cuda.get_rng_state_all() if torch.cuda.is_available() else []}, path)


def load_game(path, device="cpu"):
    saved = torch.load(path, map_location=device, weights_only=True)
    model = CommunicationGame(GameConfig(**saved["config"])).to(device)
    model.load_state_dict(saved["model"])
    return model, saved


def train_communication(model, directory: Path, steps=1200, batch_size=128, seed=42,
                        learning_rate=0.003, resume=None, evaluation_trials=1024):
    if steps < 1 or batch_size < 2: raise ValueError("Passos e batch inválidos")
    directory = Path(directory)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    journal = Journal(directory)
    device = next(model.parameters()).device
    generator = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(seed)
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=learning_rate)
    start = 0
    if resume:
        saved = torch.load(resume, map_location=device, weights_only=True)
        if saved["config"] != asdict(model.config): raise ValueError("Configuração do checkpoint difere")
        model.load_state_dict(saved["model"])
        optimizer.load_state_dict(saved["optimizer"])
        torch.set_rng_state(saved["torch_rng"].cpu())
        generator.set_state(saved["batch_rng"].cpu())
        if saved["cuda_rng"] and device.type == "cuda": torch.cuda.set_rng_state_all(saved["cuda_rng"])
        start = saved["step"]
    if start >= steps: raise ValueError("steps precisa superar o passo do checkpoint")
    model.train()
    for step in range(start + 1, steps + 1):
        batch = make_batch(model.config, batch_size, device, generator, "train")
        # Temperatura depende do passo absoluto para permitir retomada exata.
        temperature = max(0.4, 1.5 * math.exp(-step / 700))
        scores, messages, sender_logits = model(batch, temperature)
        loss = F.cross_entropy(scores, batch.target_index)
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss.backward()
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 5)
        optimizer.step()
        if step == 1 or step % 100 == 0 or step == steps:
            accuracy = (scores.argmax(-1) == batch.target_index).float().mean().item()
            journal.record("communication", step=step, loss=loss.item(), accuracy=accuracy, temperature=temperature)
            print(f"communication step={step} loss={loss.item():.4f} accuracy={accuracy:.3f}", flush=True)
    model.eval()
    report = {"train_domain": evaluate_communication(model, evaluation_trials, seed + 1, "train"),
              "heldout_combinations": evaluate_communication(model, evaluation_trials, seed + 2, "heldout"),
              "config": asdict(model.config), "steps": steps,
              "training": "Straight-through Gumbel-Softmax; discreto em avaliação; sem rótulos dos símbolos"}
    atomic_json(directory / "report.json", report)
    save_checkpoint(directory / "communication.pt", model, optimizer, steps, generator)
    return report

"""Painel local da v2 e console interativo da VM limitada por combustível."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
import json
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from .common import json_default
from .vm import Limits, Machine, assemble, compile_source


def read_json(path):
    try:
        return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (FileNotFoundError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return None


def compact_report(report):
    if report is None: return None
    return {"version": report["version"], "checks": report["checks"], "device": report["device"],
            "elapsed_seconds": report["elapsed_seconds"], "all_checks_passed": report["all_checks_passed"],
            "programming": {key: report["programming"][key] for key in ("solved", "total", "tasks", "heldout_scope")},
            "synthesis": {"solved_test": report["synthesis"]["solved_test"],
                          "final": report["synthesis"]["history"][-1], "test": report["synthesis"]["test"]},
            "communication": report["communication"],
            "morphology": report["morphology"],
            "world": {"evaluation": report["world"]["evaluation"], "morphology_events": report["world"]["morphology_events"]},
            "neat": {key: report["neat"][key] for key in ("nodes", "connections", "validation_mse", "structural_variation_observed")},
            "self_modification": report["self_modification"]}


def handler_for(directory):
    directory = Path(directory).resolve()

    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def log_message(self, *args): pass

        def respond(self, value, status=200, html=False):
            payload = value if html else json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False, default=json_default).encode()
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8" if html else "application/json; charset=utf-8")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
            self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
            self.send_header("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(payload)

        def do_GET(self):
            route = urlsplit(self.path).path
            if route == "/":
                self.respond(Path(__file__).with_name("dashboard.html").read_bytes(), html=True)
            elif route == "/api/state":
                self.respond({"stage": read_json(directory / "latest.json"),
                              "world": read_json(directory / "world/latest.json"),
                              "report": compact_report(read_json(directory / "report.json")),
                              "environment": read_json(directory / "environment.json")})
            elif route == "/api/programs":
                programs = []
                for path in sorted((directory / "programming/generated").glob("*.ovm"))[:64]:
                    if path.stat().st_size <= 65536:
                        programs.append({"name": path.stem, "source": path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")})
                discovered = directory / "synthesis/discovered.ovm"
                if discovered.is_file() and discovered.stat().st_size <= 65536:
                    programs.append({"name": "genetic_discovery", "source": discovered.read_text(encoding="utf-8")})
                self.respond(programs)
            else:
                self.respond({"error": "not_found"}, 404)

        def do_POST(self):
            if urlsplit(self.path).path != "/api/vm":
                self.respond({"error": "not_found"}, 404)
                return
            try:
                length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
                if not 1 <= length <= 65536:
                    self.respond({"error": "Use de 1 a 65536 bytes"}, 413)
                    return
                request = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length))
                fuel = request.get("fuel", 4000)
                if type(fuel) is not int or not 1 <= fuel <= 4000: raise ValueError("Fuel deve ser inteiro entre 1 e 4000")
                source = request["source"]
                if not isinstance(source, str): raise ValueError("Fonte precisa ser texto")
                inputs, array = request.get("inputs", []), request.get("array", [])
                if not isinstance(inputs, list) or not isinstance(array, list): raise ValueError("Entradas precisam ser listas")
                program = compile_source(source) if request.get("compile", False) else assemble(source)
                result = Machine(Limits(fuel=fuel)).run(program, inputs, array, trace=bool(request.get("trace", False)))
                self.respond(asdict(result))
            except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError, SyntaxError, UnicodeDecodeError, RecursionError) as exc:
                self.respond({"ok": False, "fault": "request", "message": str(exc)[:300]}, 400)

    return Handler


def serve(directory, host="127.0.0.1", port=8080):
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer((host, port), handler_for(directory))
    print(f"Ouroboros 2: painel na porta {server.server_port}; dados em {Path(directory).resolve()}", flush=True)
    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()

from .morphology import MorphogenicBrain, MorphologyConfig

__all__ = ["MorphogenicBrain", "MorphologyConfig"]

========================================================================================
ARQUIVO: ouroboros/v2/evolution/morphology.py
========================================================================================
"""Córtex recorrente com alteração REAL das dimensões e do grafo de conexões."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
import math

from ncps.torch import CfCCell
import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.nn import functional as F

from ...primitives.spiking_gate import SpikingGate


@dataclass
class MorphologyConfig:
    inputs: int = 12
    initial_nodes: int = 24
    min_nodes: int = 8
    max_nodes: int = 64
    sensor_nodes: int = 16
    density: float = 0.25
    growth: int = 3
    stress_threshold: float = 0.35
    prune_energy: float = 0.35

    def __post_init__(self):
        if not 1 <= self.min_nodes <= self.initial_nodes <= self.max_nodes:
            raise ValueError("Limites de neurônios inválidos")
        if not 0 < self.density <= 1 or self.sensor_nodes < 1 or self.growth < 1 or self.inputs < 1:
            raise ValueError("Configuração da morfogênese inválida")


class MorphogenicBrain(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, config=MorphologyConfig()):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        n, sensor = config.initial_nodes, config.sensor_nodes
        # Implementação upstream de CfC, não uma aproximação renomeada.
        self.sensor = CfCCell(config.inputs, sensor, backbone_units=32, backbone_layers=1)
        self.input_weight = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(n, sensor) / math.sqrt(sensor))
        self.recurrent = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(n, n) * 0.1)
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(n))
        self.motor = nn.Linear(n, 3)
        self.value = nn.Linear(n, 1)
        self.gate = SpikingGate(threshold=0.15)
        adjacency = torch.rand(n, n) < config.density
        adjacency.fill_diagonal_(False)
        self.register_buffer("adjacency", adjacency)
        self.register_buffer("utility", torch.zeros(n))
        self.node_ids = list(range(n))
        self.next_node_id = n
        self.stress_average = 0.0
        self.events = []

    @property
    def nodes(self): return self.input_weight.shape[0]

    def initial_state(self, batch):
        device = self.input_weight.device
        return {"sensor": torch.zeros(batch, self.config.sensor_nodes, device=device),
                "cortex": torch.zeros(batch, self.nodes, device=device),
                "fast": torch.zeros(batch, self.nodes, self.nodes, device=device)}

    def forward(self, observation, state=None, dt=0.15):
        if dt <= 0 or not math.isfinite(dt): raise ValueError("dt inválido")
        if state is None: state = self.initial_state(len(observation))
        if state["cortex"].shape != (len(observation), self.nodes):
            raise ValueError("Estado antigo após morfogênese; reinicie o estado no limite do episódio")
        sensor, _ = self.sensor(observation, state["sensor"], dt)
        previous, fast = state["cortex"], state["fast"]
        drive = F.linear(sensor, self.input_weight, self.bias)
        drive = drive + F.linear(previous, self.recurrent * self.adjacency)
        drive = drive + 0.1 * torch.bmm(fast, previous.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)
        cortex = torch.tanh(drive)
        gated, spikes = self.gate(cortex)
        activation = 0.5 * (cortex + gated)
        motor = self.motor(activation)
        with torch.no_grad():
            next_fast = (0.97 * fast + 0.01 * cortex.detach().unsqueeze(-1) * previous.detach().unsqueeze(-2)).clamp(-1, 1)
            if self.training:
                self.utility.lerp_(activation.detach().abs().mean(0), 0.03)
        next_state = {"sensor": sensor.detach(), "cortex": cortex.detach(), "fast": next_fast.detach()}
        return {"thrust": motor[:, :2].tanh(), "grip_logit": motor[:, 2],
                "value": self.value(activation).squeeze(-1), "spikes": spikes,
                "activation": activation, "state": next_state}

    @torch.no_grad()
    def resize(self, keep, additions=0, reason="manual"):
        """Preserva submatrizes sobreviventes, aloca novos neurônios e atualiza IDs.

        A identidade dos Parameters muda. O chamador precisa recriar o otimizador
        e os estados recorrentes, sempre na fronteira entre episódios.
        """
        keep = list(keep)
        if len(set(keep)) != len(keep) or any(i < 0 or i >= self.nodes for i in keep):
            raise ValueError("Seleção de neurônios inválida")
        old_count, new_count = self.nodes, len(keep) + additions
        if not self.config.min_nodes <= new_count <= self.config.max_nodes:
            raise ValueError("Resize excede capacidade configurada")
        if additions < 0: raise ValueError("Número de adições inválido")
        device, dtype = self.input_weight.device, self.input_weight.dtype
        k = torch.tensor(keep, device=device, dtype=torch.long)
        preserved = len(keep)
        input_weight = torch.randn(new_count, self.config.sensor_nodes, device=device, dtype=dtype) / math.sqrt(self.config.sensor_nodes)
        recurrent = torch.randn(new_count, new_count, device=device, dtype=dtype) * 0.1
        bias = torch.zeros(new_count, device=device, dtype=dtype)
        input_weight[:preserved] = self.input_weight[k]
        recurrent[:preserved, :preserved] = self.recurrent[k][:, k]
        bias[:preserved] = self.bias[k]
        adjacency = torch.rand(new_count, new_count, device=device) < self.config.density
        adjacency[:preserved, :preserved] = self.adjacency[k][:, k]
        adjacency.fill_diagonal_(False)
        utility = torch.zeros(new_count, device=device)
        utility[:preserved] = self.utility[k]
        motor = nn.Linear(new_count, 3, device=device, dtype=dtype)
        value = nn.Linear(new_count, 1, device=device, dtype=dtype)
        motor.weight[:, :preserved] = self.motor.weight[:, k]
        value.weight[:, :preserved] = self.value.weight[:, k]
        # Novos neurônios começam com influência pequena para preservar comportamento.
        motor.weight[:, preserved:] *= 0.1
        value.weight[:, preserved:] *= 0.1
        motor.bias.copy_(self.motor.bias)
        value.bias.copy_(self.value.bias)
        self.input_weight, self.recurrent, self.bias = nn.Parameter(input_weight), nn.Parameter(recurrent), nn.Parameter(bias)
        self.motor, self.value = motor, value
        self.adjacency, self.utility = adjacency, utility
        removed = [node for i, node in enumerate(self.node_ids) if i not in keep]
        added = list(range(self.next_node_id, self.next_node_id + additions))
        self.node_ids = [self.node_ids[i] for i in keep] + added
        self.next_node_id += additions
        event = {"reason": reason, "before": old_count, "after": new_count,
                 "added": added, "removed": removed, "optimizer_reset_required": True}
        self.events.append(event)
        return event

    @torch.no_grad()
    def rewire(self, count=2):
        if count < 1: return {"added": 0, "pruned": 0}
        active = self.adjacency.nonzero()
        absent = (~self.adjacency & ~torch.eye(self.nodes, device=self.adjacency.device, dtype=torch.bool)).nonzero()
        removed, added = 0, 0
        if len(active):
            strengths = self.recurrent[active[:, 0], active[:, 1]].abs()
            selected = active[strengths.argsort()[:count]]
            self.adjacency[selected[:, 0], selected[:, 1]] = False
            removed = len(selected)
        if len(absent):
            selected = absent[torch.randperm(len(absent), device=absent.device)[:count]]
            self.adjacency[selected[:, 0], selected[:, 1]] = True
            added = len(selected)
        return {"added": added, "pruned": removed}

    def adapt(self, stress, energy):
        if not (0 <= stress <= 2 and 0 <= energy <= 1): raise ValueError("Estado metabólico inválido")
        self.stress_average = 0.6 * self.stress_average + 0.4 * stress
        if energy < self.config.prune_energy and self.nodes > self.config.min_nodes:
            count = min(self.config.growth, self.nodes - self.config.min_nodes)
            discarded = set(self.utility.argsort()[:count].tolist())
            return self.resize([i for i in range(self.nodes) if i not in discarded], reason="energy_pruning")
        if self.stress_average > self.config.stress_threshold and self.nodes < self.config.max_nodes:
            count = min(self.config.growth, self.config.max_nodes - self.nodes)
            return self.resize(range(self.nodes), count, "sustained_stress_growth")
        return None

    def topology(self):
        edges = self.adjacency.nonzero().tolist()
        return {"nodes": self.nodes, "sensor_nodes": self.config.sensor_nodes, "node_ids": self.node_ids,
                "edges": [[self.node_ids[a], self.node_ids[b], float(self.recurrent[a, b].detach())] for a, b in edges],
                "edge_count": len(edges), "utility": self.utility.tolist(), "events": self.events,
                "config": asdict(self.config)}

    def export(self):
        return {"config": dict(asdict(self.config), initial_nodes=self.nodes), "state_dict": self.state_dict(),
                "node_ids": self.node_ids, "next_node_id": self.next_node_id,
                "stress_average": self.stress_average, "events": self.events}

    @classmethod
    def restore(cls, payload, device="cpu"):
        brain = cls(MorphologyConfig(**payload["config"])).to(device)
        brain.load_state_dict(payload["state_dict"])
        brain.node_ids, brain.next_node_id = payload["node_ids"], payload["next_node_id"]
        brain.stress_average, brain.events = payload["stress_average"], payload["events"]
        return brain

"""NEAT upstream evolui um controlador; exportação JSON evita pickle livre."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
import random

import neat
from neat.reporting import BaseReporter
import numpy as np
import torch

from ..common import ROOT, Journal, atomic_json
from ..world.training import navigation_teacher
from ..world.arena import ArenaConfig


def control_dataset(seed, count=64):
    generator = torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed)
    observations = torch.rand(count, 12, generator=generator) * 2 - 1
    observations[:, 4] = (observations[:, 4] + 1) / 2
    observations[:, 5] = (torch.arange(count) % 2).float()
    observations[:, 8] = (observations[:, 8] + 1) / 2
    observations[:, 11] = 1
    targets, _ = navigation_teacher(observations, ArenaConfig())
    return observations.numpy().tolist(), targets.numpy()


class StructuralReporter(BaseReporter):
    def __init__(self, journal):
        self.generation, self.history, self.journal = 0, [], journal

    def start_generation(self, generation): self.generation = generation

    def post_evaluate(self, config, population, species, best_genome):
        values = list(population.values())
        record = {"generation": self.generation, "fitness": best_genome.fitness,
                  "winner_nodes": len(best_genome.nodes),
                  "winner_edges": sum(c.enabled for c in best_genome.connections.values()),
                  "population_max_nodes": max(len(g.nodes) for g in values),
                  "population_min_nodes": min(len(g.nodes) for g in values)}
        self.history.append(record)
        self.journal.record("neat", **record)


def export_network(network):
    return {"inputs": network.input_nodes, "outputs": network.output_nodes,
            "node_evals": [{"node": n, "activation": activation.__name__, "aggregation": aggregation.__name__,
                            "bias": bias, "response": response, "links": links}
                           for n, activation, aggregation, bias, response, links in network.node_evals]}


def load_network(data):
    from neat.activations import tanh_activation
    from neat.aggregations import sum_aggregation
    activations, aggregations = {"tanh_activation": tanh_activation}, {"sum_aggregation": sum_aggregation}
    evaluations = [(item["node"], activations[item["activation"]], aggregations[item["aggregation"]],
                    item["bias"], item["response"], item["links"]) for item in data["node_evals"]]
    return neat.nn.FeedForwardNetwork(data["inputs"], data["outputs"], evaluations)


def evolve_controller(directory, generations=20, seed=42, config_path=None):
    if generations < 1: raise ValueError("Gerações devem ser positivas")
    directory = Path(directory)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    config_path = config_path or ROOT / "configs/v2/neat-control.ini"
    random.seed(seed)
    config = neat.Config(neat.DefaultGenome, neat.DefaultReproduction, neat.DefaultSpeciesSet,
                         neat.DefaultStagnation, str(config_path))
    inputs, targets = control_dataset(seed)

    def fitness(genomes, current_config):
        for _, genome in genomes:
            network = neat.nn.FeedForwardNetwork.create(genome, current_config)
            outputs = np.array([network.activate(row) for row in inputs])
            error = float(np.square(outputs - targets).mean())
            genome.fitness = 1 / (1 + error)

    population = neat.Population(config)
    reporter = StructuralReporter(Journal(directory))
    population.add_reporter(reporter)
    winner = population.run(fitness, generations)
    network = neat.nn.FeedForwardNetwork.create(winner, config)
    validation_inputs, validation_targets = control_dataset(seed + 10_000, 128)
    validation_error = float(np.square(np.array([network.activate(row) for row in validation_inputs]) - validation_targets).mean())
    report = {"history": reporter.history, "validation_mse": validation_error, "nodes": len(winner.nodes),
              "connections": sum(c.enabled for c in winner.connections.values()),
              "structural_variation_observed": any(row["population_max_nodes"] > 2 for row in reporter.history),
              "task": "Imitação de controle de navegação; não mede inteligência geral"}
    atomic_json(directory / "controller.json", export_network(network))
    atomic_json(directory / "report.json", report)
    return network, report

"""Orquestra experimentos reais e publica seus resultados, incluindo falhas."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict
import json
from pathlib import Path
import time

import torch

from .common import Journal, atomic_json, device_for, new_run, seed_everything
from .communication import CommunicationGame, GameConfig, train_communication
from .evolution import MorphogenicBrain, MorphologyConfig
from .evolution.neat_control import evolve_controller
from .integrations import doctor
from .programming.evaluation import evaluate
from .programming.genetics import GeneticProgrammer
from .programming.library import ToolLibrary
from .programming.organism import ProgramOrganism
from .programming.tasks import affine_task, curriculum, make_task
from .programming.token_model import TokenProgrammer, supervised_bootstrap
from .vm import assemble, disassemble
from .world import ArenaConfig
from .world.training import train_world


PROFILES = {
    "quick": {"program_epochs": 100, "communication_steps": 150, "world_episodes": 4,
              "genetic_generations": 60, "neat_generations": 5},
    "full": {"program_epochs": 400, "communication_steps": 1500, "world_episodes": 24,
             "genetic_generations": 120, "neat_generations": 25},
}


def bootstrap_programmer(directory, epochs=400, seed=42, device="cpu"):
    directory = Path(directory)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    seed_everything(seed)
    tasks = curriculum(seed)
    model = TokenProgrammer().to(device)
    journal = Journal(directory)
    history = supervised_bootstrap(model, tasks, epochs=epochs, seed=seed,
                                   callback=lambda record: journal.record("program_bootstrap", **record))
    reports, generated = [], directory / "generated"
    generated.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        for task in tasks:
            program, _, _, tokens = model.generate(task.context(device), greedy=True)
            result = evaluate(program, task.test) if program else None
            record = {"task": task.name, "valid": program is not None, "test": asdict(result) if result else None,
                      "solved": bool(result and result.solved), "tokens": len(tokens),
                      "test_unique_inputs": len({(case.inputs, case.array) for case in task.test}),
                      "instructions": len(program.code) if program else 0}
            reports.append(record)
            if program:
                (generated / (task.name + ".ovm")).write_text(disassemble(program), encoding="utf-8")
                atomic_json(generated / (task.name + ".json"), program.to_dict())
    # Avalia também novos conjuntos de exemplos públicos; não seleciona pesos com eles.
    context_checks = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        for task in tasks:
            for repetition in range(5):
                context_seed = seed + 50_000 + repetition
                public = make_task(task.name, context_seed, counts=(8, 0, 0))
                candidate, *_ = model.generate(public.context(device), greedy=True)
                result = evaluate(candidate, task.test) if candidate else None
                context_checks.append({"task": task.name, "context_seed": context_seed,
                                       "solved": bool(result and result.solved)})
    report = {"history": history, "tasks": reports, "solved": sum(r["solved"] for r in reports),
              "total": len(reports), "heldout_scope": "Novas entradas e comprimentos para famílias de algoritmos demonstradas"}
    report["public_context_generalization"] = {"solved": sum(r["solved"] for r in context_checks),
                                                "total": len(context_checks), "checks": context_checks}
    atomic_json(directory / "report.json", report)
    # Salva apenas pesos e tensores, carregáveis com weights_only=True.
    torch.save({"schema": 2, "model": model.state_dict(), "hidden": model.hidden_size,
                "context_size": model.context_size, "seed": seed}, directory / "token_programmer.pt")
    atomic_json(directory / "public_examples.json", [dict(name=t.name, cases=[c.to_dict() for c in t.train]) for t in tasks])
    return model, report


def run_synthesis(directory, generations=120, seed=42, coefficients=(3, 2, -1), task_override=None):
    directory = Path(directory)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    journal = Journal(directory)
    # O solver acessa task.train; o programa de referência nunca é fornecido à busca.
    task = task_override or affine_task(*coefficients, seed=seed)
    if any(len(case.inputs) != 2 or case.array for case in task.train):
        raise ValueError("A busca genética de árvores usa dois escalares; use generate para bytecode com arrays e loops")
    solver = GeneticProgrammer(generations=generations, seed=seed)
    candidate, history = solver.search(task, callback=lambda r: journal.record("genetics", **r))
    validation, test = evaluate(candidate, task.validation), evaluate(candidate, task.test)
    (directory / "discovered.ovm").write_text(disassemble(candidate), encoding="utf-8")
    atomic_json(directory / "discovered.json", candidate.to_dict())
    atomic_json(directory / "examples.json", {"public_training": [c.to_dict() for c in task.train],
                                               "validation": [c.to_dict() for c in task.validation],
                                               "test": [c.to_dict() for c in task.test]})
    report = {"coefficients": None if task_override else coefficients, "task": task.name,
              "history": history, "validation": asdict(validation),
              "test": asdict(test), "solved_test": test.solved, "candidate": candidate.to_dict(),
              "scope": "Síntese de composição afim sem seed de solução; não prova novidade científica"}
    atomic_json(directory / "report.json", report)
    return report


def structural_experiment(directory, seed=42, device="cpu"):
    seed_everything(seed)
    directory = Path(directory)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    brain = MorphogenicBrain(MorphologyConfig(initial_nodes=12)).to(device)
    before = brain.topology()
    initial_parameters = sum(p.numel() for p in brain.parameters())
    for _ in range(2):
        brain.adapt(stress=1.0, energy=0.9)
    brain.adapt(stress=0.1, energy=0.1)
    rewiring = brain.rewire(3)
    # Um passo de treino após resize verifica que os novos Parameters participam.
    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(brain.parameters(), lr=0.001)
    output = brain(torch.randn(8, 12, device=device))
    loss = output["thrust"].square().mean() + output["value"].square().mean()
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()
    report = {"before": before, "after": brain.topology(), "events": brain.events,
              "parameter_count_before": initial_parameters,
              "parameter_count_after": sum(p.numel() for p in brain.parameters()),
              "loss_after_resize": float(loss.detach()), "rewiring": rewiring,
              "scope": "Regra estrutural explícita guiada por energia e estresse; não organogênese espontânea"}
    atomic_json(directory / "report.json", report)
    torch.save(brain.export(), directory / "morphology.pt")
    return report


def self_modification_experiment(model, directory, seed=42):
    directory = Path(directory)
    organism = ProgramOrganism(model, directory)
    task = make_task("sum", seed)
    baseline = assemble("INPUT 0\nINPUT 1\nADD\nNOP\nNOP\nOUTPUT\nHALT", "redundant_sum")
    first = organism.library.promote(0, "sum", baseline, task)
    with torch.no_grad():
        replacement, *_ = model.generate(task.context(next(model.parameters()).device), greedy=True)
    second = (organism.library.promote(0, "sum", replacement, task, require_improvement=True)
              if replacement else {"accepted": False, "reason": "invalid_neural_program"})
    called = organism.library.call(0, (17, -9))
    attempts = []
    for name in ("sum", "array_sum", "gcd", "factorial"):
        _, record = organism.attempt(make_task(name, seed), learn=True, greedy=False)
        attempts.append(record)
    report = {"initial_promotion": first, "neural_revision": second,
              "runtime_call": asdict(called), "runtime_expected": 8,
              "metabolism": asdict(organism.metabolism), "online_attempts": attempts,
              "scope": "O agente revisa ferramentas em bytecode; não altera a VM, testes ou Python do host"}
    torch.save({"model": model.state_dict(), "optimizer": organism.optimizer.state_dict(),
                "metabolism": asdict(organism.metabolism)}, directory / "online_programmer.pt")
    atomic_json(directory / "report.json", report)
    return report


def run_experiment(directory, profile="full", seed=42, device="auto", overrides=None):
    if profile not in PROFILES: raise ValueError("Perfil desconhecido")
    directory = new_run(Path(directory))
    configuration = dict(PROFILES[profile], **(overrides or {}))
    actual_device = device_for(device)
    journal, started = Journal(directory), time.monotonic()
    environment = doctor()
    if not all(record["ok"] for record in environment["upstream"]):
        raise RuntimeError("As fontes upstream diferem dos hashes registrados")
    atomic_json(directory / "environment.json", environment)
    atomic_json(directory / "config.json", dict(profile=profile, seed=seed, device=str(actual_device), **configuration))

    def stage(name):
        journal.record("stage", stage=name, completed=False)
        print(f"\nOuroboros 2 — {name}", flush=True)

    stage("programming")
    programmer, programming = bootstrap_programmer(directory / "programming", configuration["program_epochs"], seed, actual_device)
    stage("genetic_synthesis")
    synthesis = run_synthesis(directory / "synthesis", configuration["genetic_generations"], seed)
    stage("tool_self_modification")
    self_modification = self_modification_experiment(programmer, directory / "self_modification", seed)
    communication, languages = {}, {}
    for protocol in ("free", "factorized"):
        stage("communication_" + protocol)
        seed_everything(seed)
        language = CommunicationGame(GameConfig(protocol=protocol)).to(actual_device)
        communication[protocol] = train_communication(language, directory / ("communication_" + protocol),
                                                     steps=configuration["communication_steps"], seed=seed)
        languages[protocol] = language
    stage("structural_morphology")
    morphology = structural_experiment(directory / "morphology", seed, actual_device)
    stage("neat_evolution")
    _, neat_report = evolve_controller(directory / "neat", configuration["neat_generations"], seed)
    stage("cooperative_world")
    seed_everything(seed)
    _, world = train_world(languages["factorized"], directory / "world", configuration["world_episodes"],
                           ArenaConfig(batch=32, horizon=80), seed=seed)
    causal = communication["factorized"]["train_domain"]
    checks = {"all_demonstrated_program_families": programming["solved"] == programming["total"],
              "unseen_affine_composition": synthesis["solved_test"],
              "tool_revision_accepted": bool(self_modification["neural_revision"]["accepted"]),
              "communication_causal_effect": causal["intact"]["accuracy"] >= 0.85 and causal["causal_drop_muted"] >= 0.4,
              "actual_growth_and_pruning": any(e["added"] for e in morphology["events"]) and any(e["removed"] for e in morphology["events"]),
              "neat_structural_evolution": neat_report["structural_variation_observed"],
              "world_cooperation": world["evaluation"]["intact"]["success_rate"] > 0.35 and world["evaluation"]["solo"]["successes"] == 0}
    report = {"version": "2.0.0", "profile": profile, "seed": seed, "device": str(actual_device),
              "elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started, "checks": checks,
              "programming": programming, "synthesis": synthesis, "self_modification": self_modification,
              "communication": communication, "morphology": morphology, "neat": neat_report,
              "world": world, "all_checks_passed": all(checks.values())}
    atomic_json(directory / "report.json", report)
    journal.record("completed", stage="completed", completed=True, checks=checks,
                   all_checks_passed=report["all_checks_passed"])
    return report

"""Inventário, integridade e ativação das peças upstream incluídas na entrega."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
from pathlib import Path

from .common import ROOT


def verify_upstream(directory=None):
    root = Path(directory or ROOT / "third_party")
    lock = json.loads((root / "UPSTREAM_LOCK.json").read_text())
    reports = []
    for project in lock["projects"]:
        missing, mismatched = [], []
        for relative, digest in project["files"].items():
            path = root / project["name"] / relative
            if not path.is_file(): missing.append(relative)
            elif hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != digest: mismatched.append(relative)
        reports.append({"name": project["name"], "version": project["version"],
                        "commit": project["commit"], "repository": project["repository"],
                        "license": project["license"], "files": len(project["files"]),
                        "missing": missing, "mismatched": mismatched,
                        "ok": not missing and not mismatched})
    return reports


def doctor():
    import torch
    packages = {}
    for name in ("torch", "numpy", "PyYAML", "ncps", "neat-python", "pettingzoo", "gymnasium"):
        try: packages[name] = importlib.metadata.version(name)
        except importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError: packages[name] = None
    from ncps.torch import CfCCell
    import neat
    from pettingzoo import ParallelEnv
    return {"packages": packages, "cuda_available": torch.cuda.is_available(),
            "upstream": verify_upstream(),
            "integrations": {"CfCCell": CfCCell.__module__, "NEAT": neat.__file__, "ParallelEnv": ParallelEnv.__module__}}

"""Geração autorregressiva, programação genética e promoção de ferramentas."""

========================================================================================
ARQUIVO: ouroboros/v2/programming/evaluation.py
========================================================================================
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import math

from ..vm import Limits, Machine, Program


@dataclass
class Evaluation:
    passed: int
    total: int
    error: float
    faults: dict[str, int]
    mean_steps: float

    @property
    def solved(self):
        return self.total > 0 and self.passed == self.total

    @property
    def reward(self):
        if not self.total: return -1.0
        # Um erro não pode ser compensado por baixo tempo de execução.
        return 1.0 if self.solved else -min(1.0, self.error) - 0.25 * sum(self.faults.values()) / self.total


def evaluate(program: Program, cases, limits=Limits(), tools=None):
    machine = Machine(limits, tools)
    passed, errors, steps, faults = 0, [], [], {}
    for case in cases:
        result = machine.run(program, case.inputs, case.array)
        steps.append(result.steps)
        if not result.ok or len(result.outputs) != 1:
            kind = result.fault or "output_count"
            faults[kind] = faults.get(kind, 0) + 1
            errors.append(10.0)
            continue
        error = abs(result.outputs[0] - case.expected) / max(1, abs(case.expected))
        correct = math.isclose(result.outputs[0], case.expected, rel_tol=1e-7, abs_tol=1e-7)
        passed += int(correct)
        errors.append(min(10.0, error))
    total = len(errors)
    return Evaluation(passed, total, sum(errors) / max(1, total), faults, sum(steps) / max(1, total))

========================================================================================
ARQUIVO: ouroboros/v2/programming/generation.py
========================================================================================
"""Geração de código para novas especificações, com orçamento e teste externo."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict
from pathlib import Path

import torch

from ..common import atomic_json
from ..vm import disassemble
from .evaluation import evaluate
from .token_model import TokenProgrammer


def load_programmer(path, device="cpu"):
    checkpoint = torch.load(path, map_location=device, weights_only=True)
    model = TokenProgrammer(hidden=checkpoint["hidden"], context_size=checkpoint["context_size"]).to(device)
    model.load_state_dict(checkpoint["model"])
    return model.eval()


@torch.no_grad()
def generate_candidates(model, task, directory, samples=16):
    if not 1 <= samples <= 256: raise ValueError("Use de 1 a 256 amostras")
    directory = Path(directory)
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    device = next(model.parameters()).device
    candidates, results = [], []
    for index in range(samples):
        program, *_ = model.generate(task.context(device), greedy=index == 0, temperature=0.8)
        result = evaluate(program, task.validation) if program else None
        results.append({"candidate": index, "valid": program is not None,
                        "validation": asdict(result) if result else None})
        if program:
            candidates.append((program, result, index))
            (directory / f"candidate_{index:04d}.ovm").write_text(disassemble(program), encoding="utf-8")
    if candidates:
        # O teste final não participa da escolha do candidato.
        best, validation, index = max(candidates, key=lambda row: (row[1].passed / row[1].total, -row[1].error, -len(row[0].code)))
        test = evaluate(best, task.test)
        report = {"task": task.name, "selected": index, "validation": asdict(validation),
                  "test": asdict(test), "solved": test.solved, "candidates": results}
        atomic_json(directory / "selected.json", best.to_dict())
    else:
        report = {"task": task.name, "selected": None, "solved": False, "candidates": results}
    atomic_json(directory / "report.json", report)
    return report

ARQUIVO: ouroboros/v2/programming/genetics.py

"""Programação genética de árvores abertas e mutações de bytecode.

Terminais e operadores formam uma gramática, não um catálogo de soluções.
Novas composições são construídas por cruzamento e mutação de subárvores.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
import random

from ..vm import Instruction, Program
from .evaluation import evaluate


OPERATORS = ("ADD", "SUB", "MUL", "MIN", "MAX")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Tree:
    op: str
    value: int = 0
    left: Tree | None = None
    right: Tree | None = None

    def nodes(self):
        yield ()
        if self.left:
            for path in self.left.nodes(): yield (0,) + path
        if self.right:
            for path in self.right.nodes(): yield (1,) + path

    def subtree(self, path):
        if not path: return self
        child = self.left if path[0] == 0 else self.right
        return child.subtree(path[1:])

    def replace(self, path, replacement):
        if not path: return replacement
        if path[0] == 0:
            return Tree(self.op, self.value, self.left.replace(path[1:], replacement), self.right)
        return Tree(self.op, self.value, self.left, self.right.replace(path[1:], replacement))

    @property
    def depth(self):
        return 1 + max(self.left.depth if self.left else 0, self.right.depth if self.right else 0)

    def instructions(self):
        if self.op in {"INPUT", "PUSH"}:
            return [Instruction(self.op, self.value)]
        return self.left.instructions() + self.right.instructions() + [Instruction(self.op)]

    def program(self):
        return Program(tuple(self.instructions() + [Instruction("OUTPUT"), Instruction("HALT")]), "genetic_generated")

    def expression(self):
        if self.op == "INPUT": return ("x", "y")[self.value]
        if self.op == "PUSH": return str(self.value)
        if self.op in {"MIN", "MAX"}: return f"{self.op.lower()}({self.left.expression()}, {self.right.expression()})"
        operator = {"ADD": "+", "SUB": "-", "MUL": "*"}[self.op]
        return f"({self.left.expression()} {operator} {self.right.expression()})"


def random_tree(rng, depth):
    if depth <= 1 or rng.random() < 0.28:
        return Tree("INPUT", rng.randrange(2)) if rng.random() < 0.65 else Tree("PUSH", rng.randint(-3, 3))
    return Tree(rng.choice(OPERATORS), left=random_tree(rng, depth - 1), right=random_tree(rng, depth - 1))


class GeneticProgrammer:
    def __init__(self, population=96, generations=100, max_depth=7, seed=42):
        if population < 8 or generations < 1 or max_depth < 2:
            raise ValueError("População >= 8, gerações >= 1 e profundidade >= 2")
        self.population, self.generations, self.max_depth = population, generations, max_depth
        self.rng = random.Random(seed)
        self.cache = {}

    def search(self, task, callback=None):
        self.cache.clear()
        population = [random_tree(self.rng, self.rng.randint(2, min(5, self.max_depth))) for _ in range(self.population)]
        history, champion = [], None

        def score(tree):
            key = tree
            if key not in self.cache:
                evaluation = evaluate(tree.program(), task.train)
                # Complexidade só desempata; nenhum ganho de velocidade compensa incorreção.
                self.cache[key] = (evaluation.error, sum(1 for _ in tree.nodes()), evaluation)
            error, size, evaluation = self.cache[key]
            return error + size * 0.00001, evaluation

        for generation in range(self.generations):
            ranked = sorted(population, key=lambda tree: score(tree)[0])
            champion = ranked[0]
            evaluation = score(champion)[1]
            record = dict(generation=generation, error=evaluation.error, solved_training=evaluation.solved,
                          nodes=sum(1 for _ in champion.nodes()), expression=champion.expression())
            history.append(record)
            if callback: callback(record)
            if evaluation.solved: break
            children = ranked[:max(2, self.population // 12)]

            def tournament():
                return min(self.rng.sample(ranked, 4), key=lambda tree: score(tree)[0])

            while len(children) < self.population:
                parent = tournament()
                path = self.rng.choice(list(parent.nodes()))
                if self.rng.random() < 0.55:
                    donor = tournament()
                    replacement = donor.subtree(self.rng.choice(list(donor.nodes())))
                else:
                    replacement = random_tree(self.rng, self.rng.randint(1, 4))
                child = parent.replace(path, replacement)
                if child.depth <= self.max_depth:
                    children.append(child)
                elif self.rng.random() < 0.1:
                    children.append(random_tree(self.rng, 3))
            population = children
        return champion.program(), history


def mutate_bytecode(program, rng, probability=0.15):
    """Mutação geral para candidatos neurais, incluindo operandos e fluxo.

    Saltos absolutos mantêm limites estáticos. Falhas de pilha ou loops são
    avaliados pela VM e não derrubam o processo de busca.
    """
    instructions = list(program.code)
    for i, instruction in enumerate(instructions):
        if rng.random() >= probability: continue
        op, arg = instruction.op, instruction.arg
        if op in {"JMP", "JZ", "JNZ"}:
            instructions[i] = Instruction(op, rng.randrange(len(instructions)))
        elif op == "PUSH":
            instructions[i] = Instruction(op, int(arg) + rng.choice((-2, -1, 1, 2)))
        elif op in OPERATORS:
            instructions[i] = Instruction(rng.choice(OPERATORS))
        elif op == "INPUT":
            instructions[i] = Instruction(op, rng.randrange(2))
    return Program(tuple(instructions), "bytecode_mutation").validate()

ARQUIVO: ouroboros/v2/programming/library.py

"""Autoalteração delimitada: substituições versionadas de ferramentas da VM.

O agente muda seu repertório executável. A VM e os critérios de aprovação
permanecem no host; uma ferramenta não recebe acesso ao filesystem ou ao Python.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict
import json
from pathlib import Path

from ..common import atomic_json, stable_hash
from ..vm import Instruction, Limits, Machine, Program
from .evaluation import evaluate


class ToolLibrary:
    def __init__(self, directory: Path):
        self.directory = Path(directory)
        self.directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.path = self.directory / "registry.json"
        self.registry = json.loads(self.path.read_text()) if self.path.is_file() else {"schema": 1, "tools": {}, "history": []}

    def programs(self):
        return {int(key): Program.from_dict(item["program"]) for key, item in self.registry["tools"].items()}

    def callable_programs(self):
        return {key: Program(tuple(Instruction("RET") if i.op == "HALT" else i for i in program.code), program.name)
                for key, program in self.programs().items()}

    def _check_calls(self, tool_id, program):
        programs = self.programs()
        programs[tool_id] = program
        graph = {key: {i.arg for i in p.code if i.op == "CALL"} for key, p in programs.items()}
        visiting, visited = set(), set()

        def walk(key):
            if key in visiting: raise ValueError("Chamadas recursivas não são promovidas")
            if key in visited: return
            if key not in graph: raise ValueError("Chamada para ferramenta ausente")
            visiting.add(key)
            for child in graph[key]: walk(child)
            visiting.remove(key)
            visited.add(key)

        walk(tool_id)

    def promote(self, tool_id, name, candidate, task, require_improvement=False):
        if type(tool_id) is not int or not 0 <= tool_id < 256:
            raise ValueError("Identificador de ferramenta inválido")
        candidate.validate()
        self._check_calls(tool_id, candidate)
        validation = evaluate(candidate, task.validation, tools=self.callable_programs())
        if not validation.solved:
            return {"accepted": False, "reason": "validation_failed", "evaluation": asdict(validation)}
        # O conjunto final de teste é reservado para relatório posterior, não promoção.
        previous = self.registry["tools"].get(str(tool_id))
        if previous and require_improvement:
            old = evaluate(Program.from_dict(previous["program"]), task.validation, tools=self.callable_programs())
            if old.solved and validation.mean_steps >= old.mean_steps:
                return {"accepted": False, "reason": "no_fuel_improvement"}
        revision = 1 if previous is None else previous["revision"] + 1
        record = {"id": tool_id, "name": name, "revision": revision, "program": candidate.to_dict(),
                  "fingerprint": candidate.fingerprint, "validation": asdict(validation),
                  "parent": previous["fingerprint"] if previous else None}
        self.registry["history"].append({"tool": tool_id, "previous": previous, "next": record})
        self.registry["tools"][str(tool_id)] = record
        atomic_json(self.path, self.registry)
        return {"accepted": True, "revision": revision, "fingerprint": candidate.fingerprint}

    def rollback(self, tool_id):
        for event in reversed(self.registry["history"]):
            if event["tool"] == tool_id and not event.get("reverted"):
                if event["previous"] is None:
                    self.registry["tools"].pop(str(tool_id), None)
                else:
                    self.registry["tools"][str(tool_id)] = event["previous"]
                event["reverted"] = True
                atomic_json(self.path, self.registry)
                return True
        return False

    def call(self, tool_id, inputs=(), array=()):
        # OUTPUT permanece no corpo da ferramenta; RET devolve ao chamador.
        programs = self.programs()
        if tool_id not in programs: raise KeyError(tool_id)
        tools = self.callable_programs()
        caller = Program((Instruction("CALL", tool_id), Instruction("HALT")), "tool_caller")
        return Machine(tools=tools).run(caller, inputs, array)

ARQUIVO: ouroboros/v2/programming/organism.py
========================================================================================
"""Ciclo de percepção, geração, execução, metabolismo e revisão de ferramentas."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from pathlib import Path
import random

import torch

from ..common import Journal, atomic_json
from ..vm import disassemble
from .evaluation import evaluate
from .genetics import mutate_bytecode
from .library import ToolLibrary


@dataclass
class ProgrammerMetabolism:
    energy: float = 1.0
    stress: float = 0.0
    failures: int = 0
    successes: int = 0
    resets: int = 0

    def update(self, evaluation, program_length):
        reward = evaluation.reward if evaluation else -1.25
        solved = bool(evaluation and evaluation.solved)
        fuel = evaluation.mean_steps if evaluation else 0
        self.energy = max(0., min(1., self.energy - 0.002 - program_length * 0.00001 - fuel * 0.000005 + (0.025 if solved else 0)))
        self.stress = max(0., min(2., 0.9 * self.stress + 0.1 * max(0., -reward)))
        self.failures += int(not solved)
        self.successes += int(solved)
        if self.energy <= 0:
            self.resets += 1
            self.energy, self.stress = 0.7, 0.0
        return reward


class ProgramOrganism:
    def __init__(self, model, directory, learning_rate=0.0002):
        self.model = model
        self.directory = Path(directory)
        self.directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.library = ToolLibrary(self.directory / "tools")
        self.journal = Journal(self.directory)
        self.metabolism = ProgrammerMetabolism()
        self.optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=learning_rate)
        self.baseline = 0.0
        self.attempts = 0

    def attempt(self, task, learn=True, greedy=False):
        device = next(self.model.parameters()).device
        temperature = max(0.3, min(1.2, 0.5 + 0.3 * self.metabolism.stress))
        context = task.context(device)
        program, log_probability, entropy, tokens = self.model.generate(context, temperature=temperature, greedy=greedy)
        evaluation = evaluate(program, task.train, tools=self.library.callable_programs()) if program else None
        reward = self.metabolism.update(evaluation, len(program.code) if program else 0)
        if learn:
            loss = -(reward - self.baseline) * log_probability - 0.001 * entropy
            self.optimizer.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(self.model.parameters(), 1)
            self.optimizer.step()
        self.baseline = 0.9 * self.baseline + 0.1 * reward
        self.attempts += 1
        record = {"attempt": self.attempts, "task": task.name, "reward": reward,
                  "valid": program is not None, "metabolism": asdict(self.metabolism),
                  "training_evaluation": asdict(evaluation) if evaluation else None,
                  "token_count": len(tokens)}
        self.journal.record("programmer", **record)
        if program:
            generated = self.directory / "programs"
            generated.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            stem = f"{self.attempts:05d}"
            (generated / (stem + ".ovm")).write_text(disassemble(program), encoding="utf-8")
            atomic_json(generated / (stem + ".json"), {"program": program.to_dict(), **record})
        return program, record

    def improve_and_promote(self, tool_id, task, candidates=16, seed=42):
        rng = random.Random(seed)
        with torch.no_grad():
            initial, *_ = self.model.generate(task.context(next(self.model.parameters()).device), greedy=True)
        if initial is None:
            return {"accepted": False, "reason": "neural_candidate_invalid"}
        best, best_error = initial, evaluate(initial, task.train).error
        for _ in range(candidates):
            candidate = mutate_bytecode(best, rng)
            result = evaluate(candidate, task.train)
            if result.error < best_error:
                best, best_error = candidate, result.error
        promotion = self.library.promote(tool_id, task.name, best, task)
        self.journal.record("tool_promotion", task=task.name, tool_id=tool_id, **promotion)
        return promotion
